verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for an analytics SaaS with public APIs, so the axis applies. The pack documents the Data API, the Admin API and an MCP server, but nothing about issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials such as OAuth scopes, service-account roles or read-only keys. Admin API management of Measurement Protocol secret keys (docs-17) is an adjacent ingestion-secret feature with no documented scoping or least-privilege controls, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
